name: Flavius Martis (Flamen Martialis)
notes: Mars priest of the unit. Red linothorax paludamentum, sacred hasta spear. Tends the unit's Mars observances.
gm_notes: NPC Flamen Martialis. Increasingly troubled by the corruption signs from the vault. Has been filing private prayers that he does not share with Paterculus. DC 13 Religion: he has been performing purification rites more frequently than the calendar requires -- something is wrong with the sanctity of the unit and he knows it. He does not know what is in the vault. He knows the Mars observances are not working as they should.
